articles.summary: GLENS FALLS, N.Y. (December 4, 2025) — Arrow Financial Corporation (NasdaqGS® - AROW) is pleased to announce the appointment of Darrin Jahnel to the Arrow Financial Corporation Board of Directors, effective November 25, 2025.* Jahnel, a dynamic CEO, entrepreneur and AI expert, brings more than 25 years of experience building and scaling high-growth technology companies.
